title: VoyeurVerite Scroll Animation
description: Pinned hero scrubbed over five viewport heights with four manual phases: the foreground image clips into a central vertical slit while a dark overlay fades in, then rotates to 65deg, scales to zero over sliding background text columns as a red overlay flashes on, and finally two outro images wipe in via clip-path from top and bottom before a SplitText line-masked headline staggers up at 90% progress.

images.desc: silhouetted figure in profile against foggy darkness cut by orange-red laser beams and hazy spotlights, distant crowd silhouettes
images.role: foreground hero image that clips to a slit, rotates and scales away

images.desc: man in silhouette standing in a corridor before glowing orange and red curved light panels, James Turrell style
images.role: left outro image, revealed top-down via clip-path

images.desc: lone silhouette standing inside a fan of red laser lines sweeping across a dark warehouse floor
images.role: right outro image, revealed bottom-up via clip-path

intent.useWhen: Úsalo para un hero de apertura cinematográfico que se desarma al hacer scroll, con imágenes en rendija y un titular editorial al final.
